tracks.title: Hollow Muster
tracks.intent: A stiff D-minor funeral march: low brass calls, clipped snare and squared bass. A four-bar answer opens the second half.

tracks.title: Last Light
tracks.intent: Sparse E-Phrygian bell waltz over slowly bowed fifths; long decays and open beats mirror the lantern sweep and rest.

tracks.title: Undelivered
tracks.intent: Hurried A-minor ostinato, pizzicato running eighths and syncopated rim taps. A rising counterline answers the descending delivery motif.

tracks.title: Crooked Procession
tracks.intent: A lopsided 2+2+3 G-Phrygian reed dance, plucked bass and dry wood taps. The asymmetric phrase keeps the packs restless without high-frequency chatter.

tracks.title: Final Entry
tracks.intent: A C-minor prepared-key ledger in 3+2, with a low stamping pulse and restrained rising harmonies. Three clipped answers leave a two-beat gap.

tracks.title: Copper Debt
tracks.intent: D-minor counting ostinato on low prepared keys, a falling bronze-bell answer and a single offbeat wheel tap. Wide rests separate each return.

tracks.title: Iron Jurisdiction
tracks.intent: B-flat Phrygian low-brass decree in six, two weighty three-beat chain phrases, bowed fifths and deep alternating toms. No relentless high percussion.

tracks.title: Third Latch
tracks.intent: A restrained E-minor funeral waltz. A sustained reed line passes between three low key chords; the third latch falls silent before the next phrase.

tracks.title: Last Carriage
tracks.intent: F-sharp minor carriage gallop in two groups of three eighths, muted strings, a distant single roof bell and a held driver phrase after each rush.

tracks.title: Cradle Ledger
tracks.intent: A spare F-minor cradle song, two low music-box notes answered by a single high bell. Bowed open fifths leave room around the nest tell.

tracks.title: Glasshouse Rot
tracks.intent: An uneven G-sharp Phrygian glass-key pattern in 2+3, dry droplets and an off-center plucked answer; short notes keep the ground warnings clear.

tracks.title: The Late Warning
tracks.intent: Four distant D-minor towers answer across a wide stereo field. Long low bell decays and a moving upper answer mark the deliberate rotating gap.

tracks.title: Needle Debt
tracks.intent: A tightening E-Phrygian reed stitch in 3+2+2. Paired short notes stretch into a held rescue phrase every fourth bar.

tracks.title: Aperture
tracks.intent: B-flat glass harmonics form three sides of a five-beat phrase; the fourth answer is an intentional rest, echoing the missing polygon edge.

tracks.title: Oven at Dawn
tracks.intent: Low C-minor oven brass moves in slow blocks while two light plucked crumbs answer each heavy note. Warm, dry percussion replaces a constant hiss.

tracks.title: Watermark
tracks.intent: A rocking G-minor current in two groups of three, alternating low/high plucks and slow bowed tides. The held middle register marks dry ground.

tracks.title: Last Departure
tracks.intent: F-sharp minor railway keys alternate left/right signal answers over a restrained four-beat rail pulse. A held departure tone follows every third stop.

tracks.title: Unlit Wick
tracks.intent: Three isolated A-minor lights, each answered in a different register. Quiet middle bars and barely struck toms let sanctuary warnings breathe.

tracks.title: Lecture in Bone
tracks.intent: Two opposed C-sharp prepared-key voices open then snap together, with one long space before the final beat. Dry wood taps suggest a lecture pointer.

tracks.title: Green Afterlife
tracks.intent: A rising F-minor reed vine in six, answered by clipped pruning plucks. Its final phrase opens into a plain held fifth rather than adding decoration.

tracks.title: Three Names
tracks.intent: Three synthesized E-flat minor organ voices enter in offset turns, then resolve together. Each voice has its own register and stereo place, with no external vocal samples.

tracks.title: Scarlet Vespers
tracks.intent: A slow C-minor organ prayer in five, two sanctuary voices answering a descending outside-in judgment line. Deep restrained bells arrive only at phrase boundaries.

tracks.title: The Open Half
tracks.intent: A B-Phrygian split-gavel call alternates low left and high right brass phrases. A conspicuous recovery rest separates each verdict from its answer.

tracks.title: Shoulders of Wood
tracks.intent: A heavy coffin-bearing C-minor procession: unequal low brass steps, a held wooden bass and a spare reed answer.

tracks.title: Last Shift
tracks.intent: A clipped E-flat industrial count in 2+2+3, low furnace brass and dry offbeat metal-like keys.

tracks.title: Under the Lock
tracks.intent: An underwater D-minor rocking reed line, deep plucked pulses and a distant rising bell before resurfacing.

tracks.title: Borrowed Second
tracks.intent: A mechanical five-beat key phrase stops early, leaving an audible held rest before its delayed bell answer.

tracks.title: Hem of Silence
tracks.intent: A thin A-minor plucked seam crosses long quiet string planes, with paired notes opening a deliberate gap.

tracks.title: One More Yard
tracks.intent: A low B-minor shovel rhythm: grounded brass, a short raised answer and a descending collapse cadence.

tracks.title: The Unclosed Line
tracks.intent: An F-sharp prepared-key spiral travels upward through an uneven phrase and deliberately leaves its final corner open.

tracks.title: Hive Without Sun
tracks.intent: A dry F-Phrygian reed hive, three restrained answering registers and no broadband swarm noise.

tracks.title: White Corridor
tracks.intent: B-flat glass bells hang above a low walking pulse; clean spaced notes imply slipperiness without high-frequency wash.

tracks.title: Two Crossings
tracks.intent: G-minor pole strokes alternate left and right with a central held reed, a small musical crossing and return.

tracks.title: First Hairline
tracks.intent: A restrained E-minor mourning waltz, porcelain bell intervals and a quiet low key reply that separates the cracks.

tracks.title: Pressure Gauge
tracks.intent: C-sharp low brass pressure rises in measured steps, answered by a short valve-key release and a clear recovery rest.

tracks.title: The Other Room
tracks.intent: A G-sharp mirrored key question and reversed-register answer, separated in time so the ghost phrase cannot mask a tell.

tracks.title: Erased Corner
tracks.intent: A square D-minor chalk decree whose fourth corner is a rest; low tom punctuation and a plain rising answer.

tracks.title: Three Tensions
tracks.intent: Three F-Phrygian plucked string entries arrive in sequence, answered by one low bell rather than a dense arpeggio wash.

tracks.title: Black Wing Count
tracks.intent: A brisk F-sharp reed flock in three separated gestures, with dry wooden wing-like taps and broad recovery spaces.

tracks.title: Unpaid Name
tracks.intent: A C-Phrygian seal rhythm counts two short demands, then answers in a warm low register with space around each warning.

tracks.title: Mortuary Drive
tracks.intent: A broad B-flat mortuary-machine ostinato, heavy piston brass and a higher exposed-core key answer at each fourth bar.

tracks.title: The Water Remembers
tracks.intent: A drowned D-minor royal organ phrase with a slow countercurrent in the lower voice, opening into a restrained bell return.

tracks.title: Three White Steps
tracks.intent: Three E-flat Phrygian processional steps, spare organ pillars and an audible held gate between each descending response.

tracks.title: City Under Tension
tracks.intent: Slow B-flat iron-chain brass in two groups of three, a falling pylon answer and a wide shared opening.

tracks.title: Ribs of the Road
tracks.intent: A long D-minor burial-beast reed curve, three distinct rib replies and low bowed motion beneath the numbered weak points.

tracks.title: Third Toll
tracks.intent: Three E-Phrygian bronze keeper registers take turns; the active call has a clean silence before the two quieter replies.

tracks.title: Municipal Pulse
tracks.intent: A C-Phrygian civic pump pulse in 2+2+3; low prepared keys compress, then a warm organ valve reply releases the pressure.

tracks.title: Borrowed Crown
tracks.intent: A G-minor civic palanquin march, restrained organ decree and four light carrier steps giving way to a broad throne-rest cadence.

tracks.title: Arch Without Door
tracks.intent: Low B-Phrygian arch brass closes in two heavy gestures, then leaves a conspicuous central rest and a descending core answer.

tracks.title: Last Exhalation
tracks.intent: A spare F-minor respirator organ prayer, two shelter bell notes and three separated exhalation replies; no sampled breath or vocal.

tracks.title: Sand Twice
tracks.intent: A spare E-minor sandglass phrase and exact delayed answer; broad silences keep the replay countdown audible.

tracks.title: Dark Meridian
tracks.intent: F-sharp orbital organ pedals with two slow counter-registers and a hollow bell at the safe meridian.

tracks.title: Paper Angle
tracks.intent: An angular A-Phrygian plucked fold, mirrored melodic replies and abrupt empty corners; no paper-noise sample.

tracks.title: Three Arrivals
tracks.intent: Three short D-minor courier gestures rush toward separate brass accents, then leave a long low recovery answer.

tracks.title: Empty Portrait
tracks.intent: An E-flat prepared-key history of three unmistakable intervals, answered in the same order above a patient low ledger pulse.

tracks.title: Ivory Night
tracks.intent: A wide G-minor moth-shawl reed waltz; three curved phrases pause at the same broad crossing, with no hiss or wing dust.

tracks.title: Four Empty Beats
tracks.intent: C-minor metronome keys count four clean beats. A displaced low answer marks the open syncopation; gameplay never depends on sound.

tracks.title: Streets on Shoulders
tracks.intent: A monumental B-flat civic brass walk in two groups of three, quiet roof-like organ chords and an exposed-bell reply.

tracks.title: One Door Left
tracks.intent: Three dry F-minor door-knock plucks introduce a widening reed swing, then return to a calm empty threshold.

tracks.title: Names Beyond the Bell
tracks.intent: An original D-Phrygian memorial organ theme gathers fragments of a new twelve-note response, with deliberate empty spaces for the forgotten names. No vocal or sampled commercial material.

tracks.title: Empty Balcony
tracks.intent: A deserted E-flat theatre waltz; clipped ticket-key calls and dry rim replies leave room for the aisle warnings.

tracks.title: Rain in Bronze
tracks.intent: A spring-loaded D-flat bronze call in 2+2+3; low tom landings and an ascending plucked drain reply.

tracks.title: Thread Above the Street
tracks.intent: A suspended A-minor cloth-reed phrase in 3+2; broad bowed fifths and a sparse bell response keep the wind lanes legible.
